name: Thinktank

assessmentBufferPct.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
assessmentBufferPct.note: Residential: "Net Servicing Ratio (NSR) >1.01x stressed at greater of loan rate +2.0% & 7.00% P&I". Commercial/SMSF use an ICR/DSR test instead, not a buffer.

assessmentFloorRatePct.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
assessmentFloorRatePct.note: Same sentence as the buffer — assessed at the greater of (loan rate + 2.0%) and 7.00% P&I.

dtiCap.note: Residential Lending niches list states "No DTI cap, notional rent, or rental cap" — i.e. no published hard DTI ceiling.

notes.value: Residential: NSR > 1.01x, stressed at the greater of loan rate + 2.0% and 7.00% P&I. No DTI cap, no notional rent, no rental cap. SMSF (residential and commercial): serviceability is 1.50:1 minimum ICR (SMSF income + net rent + contributions) and 1.00:1 DSR — not a buffered NSR test.
notes.sourceTitle: Thinktank SMSF Lending Information & Rates v20260709

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: "Up To 80% LVR". The published rate grid only offers the 80% column for loans $100K–$3M; above $3M the highest banded LVR is 75%, and above $3.5M it is 75%. Maximum LVR and loan size also vary by location (postcode calculator).

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: The residential sheet is headed "Owner Occupied & Investment" with a single "Up To 80% LVR" figure and the same LVR rate grid; investment is priced with a +0.10% loading rather than a lower LVR ceiling. No separate investor LVR cap is published.

notes.value: Vacant land is offered to a maximum banded LVR of 75% (owner-occupied and investment). SMSF residential and commercial both to 80% LVR. Private lending to 75% LVR.
notes.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
notes.note: Land LVR read off the published Full Doc/Mid Doc rate grid, which has no 80% column for vacant land.

Full Doc: minimum 2 years' self-employed; last 2 years' company/business/financial statements + tax returns + individual tax returns. Mid Doc: self-certified income plus one of six alternatives.
value.conditions: Newly self-employed also eligible under the published niches (ABNs 3+ months).

value.evidence: Full Doc: last 2 years' company/business financial statements + tax returns + individual tax returns.
value.conditions: Individual, partnership, company and trust borrowers accepted.

value.evidence: Investment — copies of leases and confirmation of rental income required.
value.conditions: Niches sheet states there is no notional rent and no rental cap. No published shading percentage.

rules.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709 (self-employed tenure from the Niches sheet v20260116)
rules.note: Only the income types Thinktank actually documents on the public residential sheet are listed. Casual, overtime, bonus, commission and Centrelink treatment are NOT published.

altDocAvailable.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
altDocAvailable.note: "Mid Doc" is the alt-doc product, available on residential, commercial and SMSF.

altDocEvidence.value: Statement of self-certified income supported by one of: (1) Accountant's letter; (2) last 2 x BAS statements; (3) last 6 months' trading bank account statements; (4) 1 year tax return & NOA; (5) 1 year financial statement; (6) 1 year tax return & NOA plus 1 year financial statement (attracts a 0.20% rate discount).
altDocEvidence.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
altDocEvidence.note: Six options on residential; the SMSF sheet lists the same first five options for Group Servicing.

altDocMaxLvrPct.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
altDocMaxLvrPct.note: The published Mid Doc rate grid carries an 80% LVR column for residential property $100K–$3M, i.e. the same ceiling as Full Doc.

selfEmployedMinYears.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
selfEmployedMinYears.note: Full Doc self-employed: "Minimum 2 years' self-employed, last 2x years' company/business/financial statements + tax returns + individual tax returns". Mid Doc accepts one year.

oneYearFinancialsAccepted.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
oneYearFinancialsAccepted.note: Under Mid Doc: "1 year tax return & NOA" or "1 year financial statement" are each accepted as the single supporting document.

minMonthsSelfEmployedAbn.note: "Newly self-employed eligible (ABNs 3+ months)" — listed under both Residential Lending and Commercial Lending niches.

defaultIgnoredUnderAmount.note: Residential Lending niche reads "Combined paid defaults <$1,000". Read as: combined PAID defaults below $1,000 are acceptable. The sheet does not say unpaid defaults are acceptable, nor state a seasoning period.

paidDefaultsAccepted.note: Implied by "Combined paid defaults <$1,000" appearing as a stated niche. Threshold applies; no age/seasoning rule published.

offThePlanAccepted.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
offThePlanAccepted.note: "Off the plan purchases in buildings less than or equal to 10 levels are acceptable for loan amounts up to $3.5M." Same wording repeated on the Residential SMSF sheet.

postcodeRestrictionsPublished.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
postcodeRestrictionsPublished.note: Maximum LVR and loan amount vary by location; Thinktank publishes an online Postcode Calculator to check LVRs and loan sizes. "Flexible options accepting securities in country areas (<10,000 population), refer to Postcode Calculator on website." Direct URL of the calculator not found on the public resources index.

notes.value: Minimum security property value $200,000. Residential and vacant land accepted; rates are set by security type, not loan purpose. Commercial security types accepted are office, retail, industrial, multi-residential, boarding houses, specialised securities and vacant land. Country areas under 10,000 population are considered subject to the postcode calculator. SMSF residential: maximum loan for houses and apartments is $5M in major capital cities and major metro areas.
notes.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential and SMSF Lending Information & Rates v20260709 + Niches sheet v20260116

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709
minLoanAmount.note: "$100K - $5M" on residential. SMSF and commercial also start at $100K.

maxLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Thinktank Residential Lending Information & Rates v20260709

maxLoanTermYears.note: "15 to 30 years (P&I)" — the minimum term is 15 years, which is unusual and worth noting on a scenario.

smsfLendingAvailable.sourceTitle: Thinktank SMSF Lending Information & Rates v20260709
smsfLendingAvailable.note: Residential SMSF to $5M and commercial SMSF to $10M, both up to 80% LVR, terms 15–30 years P&I with up to 5 years IO. New or established SMSFs; no liquidity or net asset requirement (except Commercial Max SMSF); one or more members must be in accumulation phase for loans up to $8M.

notes.value: Thinktank is a specialist non-bank across four books: Residential ($100K–$5M, to 80% LVR, Full Doc or Mid Doc), Commercial ($100K–$10M, to 80% LVR, Full/Mid/Quick/Lease Doc), SMSF (residential to $5M and commercial to $10M, to 80% LVR) and Private lending (to $7.5M, to 75% LVR, 3 months to 3 years IO). Residential lending IS offered and is NCCP-regulated (an NCCP Residential Loan Addendum and residential TMD are published). SMSF servicing is an ICR/DSR test, not a buffered NSR: minimum 1.50:1 ICR (SMSF income + net rent + concessional and non-concessional contributions, actual or projected) and 1.00:1 DSR. Fund-only servicing is open to PAYG and self-employed investors; where group servicing is required, Full Doc or Mid Doc from the self-employed member or guarantor is acceptable. No liquidity or net asset requirement post-settlement and no annual reviews, ongoing fees or re-valuations. Complex SMSF structures considered: tenants in common for business real property, in-specie transfers of business real property, and unit trusts with SMSF unit holders.
notes.sourceTitle: Thinktank — SMSF loan specialists (broker site) + SMSF Lending Information & Rates v20260709

gaps: No published rent shading percentage — the Niches sheet says there is no notional rent and no rental cap, but does not state what fraction of gross rent is counted.
No published credit card assessment rate, HEM basis, HEM loading or existing-commitment treatment.
No published policy for casual, probation, fixed-term contract, overtime, bonus, commission, car/shift allowance or any Centrelink income type.
No published PAYG employment tenure minimum (only the 3-month ABN rule for self-employed).
Credit policy is thin: only 'combined paid defaults <$1,000' is published. No bankruptcy, Part IX, judgment, writ, arrears, enquiry or credit-score policy found.
No published minimum unit floor area, high-density apartment policy, maximum land size, rural or company-title policy.

Postcode calculator drives max LVR and max loan size by location, but the calculator's URL and the underlying category list are not on the public resources index — LVR/loan-size caps here are the headline numbers, not the location-adjusted ones.
No residency/visa policy published at all — non-resident and temporary-visa treatment unknown.
No genuine-savings, gifted-deposit, guarantor or maximum-age-at-maturity policy published.
LMI: Thinktank lends to 80% LVR and no LMI provider or LMI policy is published; whether any LMI-backed product exists is unknown.
